item.title: HarperCollins to Publish Book by Bondi Rabbi Eli Schlanger

item.title: Rambam In-Depth: Contradiction That Stumped Scholars for Centuries
item.description: A class by Rabbi Heschel Greenberg on the Rambam’s Mishneh Torah: Don't demolish a shul until the new one is built — but if the walls are collapsing, tear it down immediately and rebuild day and night without delay. Video

Full Story, Photos, Video
